इन, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. able, strong, energetic, de-
termined, bold; powerful, mighty, wild; glorious;
(अस्), m. a lord, a master; a king; the sun; the
lunar mansion Hasta.
—इन-सभ, अम्, n. a royal
court or assembly.

इनक्ष् इनक्ष्, इनक्षति (a Ved. Desid. of
नक्ष्), to endeavour to reach, strive to obtain.
इनानी इनानी, f., N. of a plant (= Vaṭapattrī).
